name: Agent Board Integration

on:
  schedule:
    # Run every 15 minutes to check for new tasks
    - cron: '*/15 * * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force_run:
        description: 'Force run even if no tasks are available'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write
  repository-projects: write

jobs:
  agent-worker:
    name: Autonomous Agent Worker
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.repository == 'AndrewAltimit/template-repo' }}
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

      - name: Cache cargo index
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-

      - name: Build agent binary
        run: |
          cargo build --release --bin agent-board-worker

      - name: Run Agent Worker
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN }}
          PROJECT_NUMBER: ${{ vars.PROJECT_NUMBER || '1' }}
          REPO_OWNER: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          REPO_NAME: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
          AGENT_NAME: "github-actions-agent"
          FORCE_RUN: ${{ github.event.inputs.force_run || 'false' }}
        run: |
          # Check if required secrets are present
          if [ -z "$GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN" ]; then
            echo "::warning::GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN not set. Skipping board integration."
            exit 0
          fi

          if [ -z "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ]; then
            echo "::error::GITHUB_TOKEN is required for repo operations."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Starting Agent Board Worker..."
          echo "Agent: $AGENT_NAME"
          echo "Project: $PROJECT_NUMBER"
          echo "Repo: $REPO_OWNER/$REPO_NAME"
          
          # Run the agent worker
          # The binary should handle:
          # 1. Querying the board for unblocked TODO tasks
          # 2. Claiming a task
          # 3. Executing the task (stubbed for now)
          # 4. Releasing the task or marking as done
          ./target/release/agent-board-worker \
            --owner "$REPO_OWNER" \
            --repo "$REPO_NAME" \
            --project-number "$PROJECT_NUMBER" \
            --agent-name "$AGENT_NAME" \
            --force "$FORCE_RUN"
